entities.summary: Església de Sant Joan de Sispony is a church located in Sispony, La Massana, Andorra, that had its construction finished in 1641. It replaced a previous Romanesque church in the area. Josep Oromí i Muntada created murals and other artwork for the church in the 19th century.
